deployments_detail.use: "plai" app (built with Aily Labs) deployed at scale — real-time AI-driven 360° data view across all activities; Sanofi aims to be first AI-powered pharma at scale (own press release, 2023)

plai — company-wide AI decision-intelligence app giving a 360-degree view across R&D, manufacturing, supply and commercial; used daily by Sanofians and 'attends' R&D portfolio decisions to advise on advancing, accelerating or halting programs [Aily Labs]
deployments_detail.value: aggregates 1+ billion data points; roughly doubled decision-making speed

deployments_detail.use: plai used for quality management across manufacturing sites — automating deviation and complaint trending, generating root-cause hypotheses, and accelerating investigations; governed by Sanofi's RAISE (Responsible AI at Sanofi Enterprise) framework [Aily Labs]

SimplY — in-house AI-powered yield analytics platform that learns from past and current batch performance (tracking thousands of live bioreactor data points) to raise manufacturing yields batch-by-batch [Sanofi (in-house)]
Collaboration with OpenAI and Formation Bio to build AI-powered software to accelerate drug development, including a tool to speed clinical-trial patient recruitment [OpenAI, Formation Bio]

Multi-year small-molecule drug discovery collaboration using AQEMIA's quantum-physics-inspired generative-AI platform combined with Sanofi's R&D, spanning the discovery journey (expanded in 2026) [AQEMIA]
deployments_detail.value: up to $140 million in upfront and milestone payments

deployments_detail.use: Five-year license and multi-year collaboration to build agentic AI 'biopharma agents' on Owkin's K Pro AI-scientist platform to autonomously support drug discovery and development workflows [Owkin]
Partnership with BioMap to co-develop AI foundation-model modules for biotherapeutic (large-molecule/biologics) drug discovery [BioMap]

AI drug discovery partnership with Insilico Medicine using generative AI to develop drugs against multiple targets; collaboration yielded an AI-facilitated first-in-class oncology lead against a previously undruggable transcription-factor target [Insilico Medicine]
Virtual (digital) twin technology to simulate and optimize tech transfer, recipes, equipment and vaccine plant design, accelerating vaccine development [Dassault Systemes (3DEXPERIENCE Virtual Twin)]
deployments_detail.value: cited up to 50% faster development in later manufacturing use

deployments_detail.use: Third Digital Accelerator (Lyon) integrating AI at scale into pharmaceutical production (own press release, 2025)
plai deployed in Manufacturing & Supply for probabilistic supply-chain planning, predicting low-inventory/stock-disruption positions to keep medicines flowing [Aily Labs]
deployments_detail.value: predicts ~80% of low-inventory positions / stock disruptions

deployments_detail.use: Using generative AI to accelerate global rollout of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) — replacing paper-based batch records with digital ones and speeding site deployments [Siemens, Capgemini]
deployments_detail.value: expected to cut MES deployment timelines in half
